name: Mutate or Lose Brainrot
desc:
💤 EGGS GROW AND MUTATION STILL PROCESSING WHILE OFFLINE!


How to Play:
🥚 Hatch eggs to get Brainrots
⭐ Mutate Brainrots to double they Cash/s — 50% to success / 50% to lose
💸 Get rare Brainrots with insane Mutations to boost your income and rise on the leaderboard.
🔄 Rebirth to keep more and more mutation if you lose


👍 Like the game and join the group!
🎮 Experience it on PC, mobile, tablet, or console, with full controller compatibility.
